<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Selected Plots — Premium Land in Nagpur</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --gold: #E87E1B;
    --gold-light: #F5A94E;
    --gold-dark: #B5600E;
    --cream: #FFFFFF;
    --deep: #2B1F14;
    --mid: #5C4A3A;
    --text: #2B1F14;
    --muted: #8A7060;
    --border: rgba(232,126,27,0.15);
    --card-bg: #FFFFFF;
    --section-bg: #FDF6EE;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--text);
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* NAV */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    padding: 0 5%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    height: 68px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232,126,27,0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }

  .nav-logo {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .logo-mark {
    width: 38px; height: 38px;
    background: var(--gold);
    clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep);
  }
  .logo-text {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  .logo-sub {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--gold-light);
    letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
    display: block; margin-top: -2px;
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex; gap: 32px; list-style: none;
  }
  .nav-links a {
    color: #5C4A3A; text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  .nav-cta {
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep);
    padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--gold-light); }

  /* HERO */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FDF6EE 0%, #FFF8F0 50%, #FDF6EE 100%);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    padding: 120px 5% 80px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      45deg,
      transparent,
      transparent 60px,
      rgba(232,126,27,0.04) 60px,
      rgba(232,126,27,0.04) 61px
    );
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  .hero-eyebrow::after {
    content: ''; display: block; width: 40px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold);
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(42px, 7vw, 88px);
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05;
    color: var(--deep); max-width: 700px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .hero h1 em { color: var(--gold); font-style: normal; }

  .hero-sub {
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; color: #8A7060;
    max-width: 420px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 44px;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep);
    padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  .btn-outline {
    background: transparent; color: var(--deep);
    padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(43,31,20,0.25);
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); }

  .hero-stats {
    display: flex; gap: 48px; margin-top: 64px;
    padding-top: 40px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(232,126,27,0.15);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #8A7060;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 6px;
  }

  /* MARQUEE STRIP */
  .strip {
    background: var(--gold);
    padding: 12px 0; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .strip-inner {
    display: flex; gap: 48px;
    animation: marquee 22s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  @keyframes marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
  .strip-item {
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--deep);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  .strip-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--deep); opacity: 0.4; }

  /* SECTIONS */
  section { padding: 80px 5%; }

  .section-eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--deep);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .section-sub {
    font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7;
    max-width: 480px; margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  /* FILTERS */
  .filter-bar {
    display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
  .filter-btn {
    padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 40px; cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: transparent; color: var(--muted);
    transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  .filter-btn:hover, .filter-btn.active {
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep); border-color: var(--gold);
  }

  /* PROPERTY GRID */
  .properties-section { background: var(--section-bg); }

  .property-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
    gap: 28px;
  }

  .property-card {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
    position: relative;
  }
  .property-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  }

  .card-image {
    width: 100%; height: 200px; object-fit: cover;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8dfc8 0%, #d4c9a8 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .card-image-placeholder {
    width: 100%; height: 200px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .card-image svg { opacity: 0.35; }

  .badge {
    position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px;
    padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 3px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .badge-available { background: #2D6A3F; color: #fff; }
  .badge-sold { background: #8B1A1A; color: #fff; }
  .badge-featured { background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep); }

  .card-body { padding: 22px 24px 24px; }

  .card-location {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--deep);
    margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .card-specs {
    display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 18px; padding-bottom: 18px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .spec {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
  }
  .spec-val {
    font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--deep);
  }
  .spec-lbl {
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .card-footer {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .card-price {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep);
  }
  .card-price span {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); display: block;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .card-btn {
    background: var(--deep); color: #fff;
    padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .card-btn:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep); }

  /* WHY SECTION */
  .why-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    gap: 28px; margin-top: 0;
  }
  .why-card {
    padding: 32px 28px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--card-bg);
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }
  .why-card:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }
  .why-icon {
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(201,168,76,0.12); color: var(--gold);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .why-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--deep);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .why-text {
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* AREAS */
  .areas-section { background: #FDF6EE; }
  .areas-section .section-title { color: var(--deep); }
  .areas-section .section-sub { color: #8A7060; }
  .area-pills {
    display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .area-pill {
    padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 40px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,126,27,0.25);
    color: #5C4A3A; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; text-decoration: none;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .area-pill:hover {
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep);
    border-color: var(--gold);
  }
  .area-count {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
    background: rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
    padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; color: var(--gold);
  }
  .area-pill:hover .area-count { background: rgba(43,31,20,0.15); color: var(--deep); }

  /* CTA SECTION */
  .cta-section {
    background: var(--gold);
    padding: 72px 5%;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .cta-section h2 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px); font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--deep); margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .cta-section p {
    font-size: 16px; color: var(--mid); margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .cta-actions { display: flex; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .cta-btn-dark {
    background: var(--deep); color: #fff;
    padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  }
  .cta-btn-dark:hover { background: var(--mid); }
  .cta-btn-white {
    background: #fff; color: var(--deep);
    padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  }
  .cta-btn-white:hover { background: var(--cream); }

  /* INSTAGRAM */
  .insta-section {
    background: var(--section-bg);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .insta-handle {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 14px 28px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--card-bg);
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .insta-handle:hover { border-color: var(--gold); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .insta-icon {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f09433 0%, #e6683c 25%, #dc2743 50%, #cc2366 75%, #bc1888 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    color: #fff; font-size: 20px;
  }
  .insta-info { text-align: left; }
  .insta-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--deep);
  }
  .insta-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer {
    background: #FDF6EE;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(232,126,27,0.15);
    padding: 48px 5% 28px;
    color: #8A7060;
  }
  .footer-top {
    display: flex; gap: 48px; justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232,126,27,0.12);
  }
  .footer-logo-area .logo-text { font-size: 20px; }
  .footer-tagline {
    font-size: 13px; color: #8A7060; margin-top: 10px;
    max-width: 220px; line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .footer-col h4 {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
  .footer-col ul li { margin-bottom: 9px; }
  .footer-col ul a {
    color: #8A7060; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .footer-col ul a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
  .footer-bottom {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
  }
  .footer-bottom a { color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; }

  /* MODAL */
  .modal-backdrop {
    display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 999;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px;
  }
  .modal-backdrop.open { display: flex; }
  .modal {
    background: var(--card-bg); border-radius: 10px;
    max-width: 560px; width: 100%; padding: 40px;
    position: relative; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .modal-close {
    position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px;
    background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 22px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1;
  }
  .modal h2 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 24px; color: var(--deep); margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .modal-loc { color: var(--gold); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .modal-specs {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .modal-spec-item {
    background: var(--section-bg); border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
  }
  .modal-spec-val { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--deep); }
  .modal-spec-lbl { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; }
  .modal-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .modal-price-row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .modal-price-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
  .modal-price-val {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep);
  }
  .modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .modal-btn-insta {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f09433, #dc2743, #bc1888);
    color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.04em; flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .modal-btn-whatsapp {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 4px;
    background: #25D366; color: #fff;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.04em; flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  /* Plot image SVG backgrounds */
  .plot-bg-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4c9a8, #c4b48a); }
  .plot-bg-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9d4a8, #a8b48a); }
  .plot-bg-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4bda8, #b48a78); }
  .plot-bg-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a8c4d4, #88a4b4); }
  .plot-bg-5 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4c8a8, #b0a070); }
  .plot-bg-6 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c8a8d4, #a070b0); }

  .plot-icon {
    font-size: 48px; opacity: 0.4;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; color: #4a3a1a;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: 38px; }
    .footer-top { flex-direction: column; gap: 32px; }
    .modal-specs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <a href="#" class="nav-logo">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Selected Plots" style="height:42px;width:auto;">
  </a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#properties">Properties</a></li>
    <li><a href="#areas">Areas</a></li>
    <li><a href="#why">Why Us</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
  <a href="https://www.instagram.com/selectedplots/" target="_blank" class="nav-cta">Instagram</a>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-eyebrow">Premium Land Investment · Nagpur</div>
  <h1>Your <em>Dream Plot</em> in the Heart of Nagpur</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">Carefully curated residential & commercial plots across Nagpur's most sought-after localities. Transparent dealings, verified titles.</p>
  <div class="hero-actions">
    <a href="#properties" class="btn-primary">View Available Plots ↓</a>
    <a href="https://www.instagram.com/selectedplots/" target="_blank" class="btn-outline">

<script>
const properties = [
  {
    id:1, title:"Wardha Road Residential Plot", area:"Wardha Road", type:"residential",
    size:"1200", unit:"sq ft", facing:"East", road:"30 ft Road",
    price:"₹48 Lakh", priceNote:"All-inclusive",
    badge:"available", featured:true,
    desc:"Prime East-facing residential plot on Wardha Road with 30ft approach road. Ready for immediate construction. Peaceful locality near schools and hospitals. Clear DTCP approved title.",
    bg:"plot-bg-1"
  },
  {
    id:2, title:"MIHAN Vicinity Investment Plot", area:"MIHAN / Nagpur Airport Zone", type:"commercial",
    size:"2400", unit:"sq ft", facing:"North", road:"40 ft Road",
    price:"₹1.1 Crore", priceNote:"Negotiable",
    badge:"available", featured:false,
    desc:"High-value commercial plot adjacent to MIHAN SEZ. Excellent investment potential with upcoming IT Park and airport expansion in the vicinity. Premium North-facing corner location.",
    bg:"plot-bg-2"
  },
  {
    id:3, title:"Hingna Road Corner Plot", area:"Hingna Road", type:"corner",
    size:"1500", unit:"sq ft", facing:"North-East", road:"24 ft & 18 ft Roads",
    price:"₹62 Lakh", priceNote:"Final Price",
    badge:"available", featured:false,
    desc:"Rare corner plot at the junction of two roads in Hingna. North-East facing as per Vastu, ideal for residence. Industrial proximity ensures excellent future appreciation.",
    bg:"plot-bg-3"
  },
  {
    id:4, title:"Bypass Road Farmland Parcel", area:"Nagpur Bypass Road", type:"farmland",
    size:"5 Acre", unit:"", facing:"South", road:"State Highway Access",
    price:"₹85 Lakh/Acre", priceNote:"Per Acre Rate",
    badge:"available", featured:true,
    desc:"Fertile farmland along Nagpur Bypass with water table access. NA conversion possible. Suitable for agri-tourism, warehouse, or future township projects. Highway frontage of 120 ft.",
    bg:"plot-bg-4"
  },
  {
    id:5, title:"Amravati Road Residential Plot", area:"Amravati Road, Nagpur", type:"residential",
    size:"900", unit:"sq ft", facing:"West", road:"20 ft Road",
    price:"₹32 Lakh", priceNote:"Best Price",
    badge:"available", featured:false,
    desc:"Compact and affordable residential plot in a fast-developing colony on Amravati Road. Gated layout, underground drainage, street lighting. Perfect first home investment.",
    bg:"plot-bg-5"
  },
  {
    id:6, title:"Katol Road Commercial Plot", area:"Katol Road, Nagpur", type:"commercial",
    size:"3200", unit:"sq ft", facing:"North", road:"60 ft Main Road",
    price:"₹1.8 Crore", priceNote:"Negotiable",
    badge:"available", featured:false,
    desc:"Prominent commercial plot on Katol Road's main arterial with 60ft frontage. Ideal for showroom, hotel, or office complex. Maximum visibility and footfall location.",
    bg:"plot-bg-6"
  }
];

let currentFilter = 'all';

function filterProps(btn, type) {
  currentFilter = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderGrid();
}

function renderGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('propertyGrid');
  const filtered = currentFilter === 'all'
    ? properties
    : properties.filter(p => p.type === currentFilter || (currentFilter === 'corner' && p.type === 'corner'));
  
  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => `
    <div class="property-card" data-id="${p.id}">
      <div class="card-image-placeholder ${p.bg}">
        ${p.featured ? '<span class="badge badge-featured">Featured</span>' : ''}
        <span class="badge badge-available" style="${p.featured?'left:auto;right:14px':''}">Available</span>
        <div style="text-align:center;opacity:0.35;">
          <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <rect x="8" y="20" width="48" height="36" rx="2" fill="#4a3a1a" opacity="0.3"/>
            <polygon points="4,22 32,4 60,22" fill="#4a3a1a" opacity="0.4"/>
            <rect x="24" y="36" width="16" height="20" fill="#4a3a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <div class="card-location">
          <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z"/></svg>
          ${p.area}
        </div>
        <div class="card-title">${p.title}</div>
        <div class="card-specs">
          <div class="spec"><span class="spec-val">${p.size} ${p.unit}</span><span class="spec-lbl">Plot Size</span></div>
          <div class="spec"><span class="spec-val">${p.facing}</span><span class="spec-lbl">Facing</span></div>
          <div class="spec"><span class="spec-val">${p.road}</span><span class="spec-lbl">Road Width</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card-footer">
          <div class="card-price">${p.price}<span>${p.priceNote}</span></div>
          <button class="card-btn" onclick="openModal(${p.id})">Details</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function openModal(id) {
  const p = properties.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!p) return;
  document.getElementById('modalContent').innerHTML = `
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()">✕</button>
    <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px">
      ${p.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+p.type.slice(1)} Plot
    </div>
    <h2>${p.title}</h2>
    <div class="modal-loc">📍 ${p.area}</div>
    <div class="modal-specs">
      <div class="modal-spec-item"><div class="modal-spec-val">${p.size} ${p.unit}</div><div class="modal-spec-lbl">Plot Size</div></div>
      <div class="modal-spec-item"><div class="modal-spec-val">${p.facing}</div><div class="modal-spec-lbl">Facing</div></div>
      <div class="modal-spec-item"><div class="modal-spec-val">${p.road}</div><div class="modal-spec-lbl">Road Width</div></div>
      <div class="modal-spec-item"><div class="modal-spec-val">Available</div><div class="modal-spec-lbl">Status</div></div>
    </div>
    <p class="modal-desc">${p.desc}</p>
    <div class="modal-price-row">
      <div><div class="modal-price-label">Listed Price</div><div class="modal-price-val">${p.price}</div></div>
      <div style="text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">${p.priceNote}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
      <a href="https://www.instagram.com/selectedplots/" target="_blank" class="modal-btn-insta">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white"><path d="M12 2.163c3.204 0 3.584.012 4.85.07 3.252.148 4.771 1.691 4.919 4.919.058 1.265.069 1.645.069 4.849 0 3.205-.012 3.584-.069 4.849-.149 3.225-1.664 4.771-4.919 4.919-1.266.058-1.644.07-4.85.07-3.204 0-3.584-.012-4.849-.07-3.26-.149-4.771-1.699-4.919-4.92-.058-1.265-.07-1.644-.07-4.849 0-3.204.013-3.583.07-4.849.149-3.227 1.664-4.771 4.919-4.919 1.266-.057 1.645-.069 4.849-.069zm0-2.163c-3.259 0-3.667.014-4.947.072-4.358.2-6.78 2.618-6.98 6.98-.059 1.281-.073 1.689-.073 4.948 0 3.259.014 3.668.072 4.948.2 4.358 2.618 6.78 6.98 6.98 1.281.058 1.689.072 4.948.072 3.259 0 3.668-.014 4.948-.072 4.354-.2 6.782-2.618 6.979-6.98.059-1.28.073-1.689.073-4.948 0-3.259-.014-3.667-.072-4.947-.196-4.354-2.617-6.78-6.979-6.98-1.281-.059-1.69-.073-4.949-.073zm0 5.838c-3.403 0-6.162 2.759-6.162 6.162s2.759 6.163 6.162 6.163 6.162-2.759 6.162-6.163c0-3.403-2.759-6.162-6.162-6.162zm0 10.162c-2.209 0-4-1.79-4-4 0-2.209 1.791-4 4-4s4 1.791 4 4c0 2.21-1.791 4-4 4zm6.406-11.845c-.796 0-1.441.645-1.441 1.44s.645 1.44 1.441 1.44c.795 0 1.439-.645 1.439-1.44s-.644-1.44-1.439-1.44z"/></svg>
        Enquire on Instagram
      </a>
      <a href="https://wa.me/919999999999?text=Hi! I'm interested in the plot: ${encodeURIComponent(p.title + ' (' + p.area + '). Price: ' + p.price)}" target="_blank" class="modal-btn-whatsapp">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white"><path d="M17.472 14.382c-.297-.149-1.758-.867-2.03-.967-.273-.099-.471-.148-.67.15-.197.297-.767.966-.94 1.164-.173.199-.347.223-.644.075-.297-.15-1.255-.463-2.39-1.475-.883-.788-1.48-1.761-1.653-2.059-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.298-.347.446-.52.149-.174.198-.298.298-.497.099-.198.05-.371-.025-.52-.075-.149-.669-1.612-.916-2.207-.242-.579-.487-.5-.669-.51-.173-.008-.371-.01-.57-.01-.198 0-.52.074-.792.372-.272.297-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 0 1.462 1.065 2.875 1.213 3.074.149.198 2.096 3.2 5.077 4.487.709.306 1.262.489 1.694.625.712.227 1.36.195 1.871.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.694.248-1.289.173-1.413-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347m-5.421 7.403h-.004a9.87 9.87 0 01-5.031-1.378l-.361-.214-3.741.982.998-3.648-.235-.374a9.86 9.86 0 01-1.51-5.26c.001-5.45 4.436-9.884 9.888-9.884 2.64 0 5.122 1.03 6.988 2.898a9.825 9.825 0 012.893 6.994c-.003 5.45-4.437 9.884-9.885 9.884m8.413-18.297A11.815 11.815 0 0012.05 0C5.495 0 .16 5.335.157 11.892c0 2.096.547 4.142 1.588 5.945L.057 24l6.305-1.654a11.882 11.882 0 005.683 1.448h.005c6.554 0 11.89-5.335 11.893-11.893a11.821 11.821 0 00-3.48-8.413z"/></svg>
        WhatsApp Enquiry
      </a>
    </div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('open');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('open');
}

// Marquee
const items = ['Wardha Road','MIHAN Zone','Hingna Road','Bypass Road','Amravati Road','Katol Road','Clear Titles','Verified Plots','Best Prices','Nagpur Land Experts'];
const m = document.getElementById('marquee');
const all = [...items,...items].map(i=>`<span class="strip-item">${i}<span class="strip-dot"></span></span>`).join('');
m.innerHTML = all + all;

renderGrid();
</script>
</body>
</html>
